basis: Preserved actual native128 meshes and editable component/material records, compared with maintained loaded profile TSV. No marketing/name capacity inference.
mesh_count_caution: Mesh-piece count is not passenger capacity: one bench can hold several players, overlapping saddle pieces form one seat, and some modes lack independently reviewed seating geometry.

driving_engine.implementation: Custom server-authoritative SDCraftCore GtmVehicles/RoadPhysics on Paper26.3; not a separate GTA or rigid-body engine.
driving_engine.controls: W/S throttle/brake-through-zero/reverse, A/D steering, Jump brake, Sneak safe exit.
driving_engine.movement: Analytic longitudinal integration, bounded bicycle-arc steering, swept accepted movement/collision, fuel/health/odometer; one ArmorStand carrier per loaded seat.
driving_engine.passenger_follow: Paper26.3 CraftEntity.teleport0 uses TeleportTransition.PassengerTeleportationMode.POSITION_RIDER; GtmVehicles transforms every carrier with the same accepted body pose.
driving_engine.limits: Custom kinematic road model, not suspension/tyre/rigid-body simulation. Native driving checked previously on flat workshop terrain; no broad slope/terrain/Bedrock certification.
